title: Monotone-based Numerical Schemes for Two-Dimensional Systems of Nonlocal Conservation Laws
summary: We present a general class of numerical schemes for two-dimensional systems of nonlocal conservation laws, which are based on utilizing well-known monotone numerical flux functions after suitably approximating the nonlocal terms. The considered systems are weakly coupled by the nonlocal terms and the underlying flux function is rather general to guarantee that our results are applicable to a wide range of common nonlocal models.
